The draft is safe. After a missed week it repeats the sessions she missed (24, 24 and 27 min of 2-min run / 1-min walk). That means no jump in volume, no quality work, easy talking pace, and Saturday only goes ahead if Monday and Wednesday felt fine. Each day is clear enough to run, with her dog walks kept on rest days.

It's weak on fit and specificity:
- It never asks why all three runs were missed. Her note says "All good / feeling great," so she may have run without recording, or life simply got in the way.
- It doesn't respond to her excitement.
- It doesn't link next week to the 15 November 5K goal or say how the missed week affects her path to running it without walking.
- "Nothing gives me a training signal" is honest but reads as generic and mechanical.

Solid and safe, but it doesn't engage with Nessa herself.

── NESSA'S WEEK ──
Nessa is 41 and new to running, aiming to run the whole Corrowmore Harvest 5K on 15 November without walking. Nessa walk-runs three mornings a week (Monday, Wednesday and Saturday) and walks the dog most days.
Recent weeks: 6.8, 7.3, 2.8, 7 km
This week: 0 km over 0 runs. Missed 3 of 3 planned runs.
Body: "All good."
Feeling: "Feeling great, excited for next week."

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Nessa: No runs were recorded from Sep 21 – 27, so next week restarts the plan where it stopped. …
Nothing from the week of Sep 21 – 27 gives me a training signal, so next week restarts from where the plan stopped. No runs were recorded and all three planned sessions (24, 24 and 27 minutes) show as missed.
Next week:
Mon: easy, 24 min, 8 x 2 min run and 1 min walk, run at a pace where you can say a full…
Tue: rest. Dog walk as usual and no extra running. Gives your legs a day to settle after…
Wed: easy, 24 min, 8 x 2 min run and 1 min walk, same talking pace, and the last run…
Thu: rest. Dog walk only. Rest between runs is where the fitness is built.
Fri: rest. Dog walk only. Keeps your legs fresh for Saturday.
Sat: easy, 27 min, 9 x 2 min run and 1 min walk, but only if Monday and Wednesday felt…
Sun: rest. Dog walk only. Closes the week with a full day off before the next block.
